faq.sousTitreSection: Everything you need to know before getting started.
faq.q1: How do I pay for a course?
faq.r1: You can pay directly on the platform using MonCash, NatCash, or your bank card.
faq.q2: How do I get access after payment?
faq.r2: Once payment is validated, access to all course lessons is unlocked instantly on your account.
faq.q3: Can I watch courses on my mobile phone?
faq.r3: Yes, the platform is specially designed to run smoothly on any smartphone.
faq.q4: What language are the courses taught in?
faq.r4: All courses are entirely taught in Haitian Creole for clear and complete comprehension.
faq.q5: How can I get help if I run into an issue?
faq.r5: You can reach support anytime through our contact page or support email.
